solve_ik_with_position_constraints: create a GaussNewtonSolver with PositionErrorFunction constraints to solve inverse kinematics for a character skeleton
solve_sequence_with_smoothness: build a SequenceSolverFunction with StateSequenceErrorFunction to solve multi-frame poses with temporal smoothness constraints
add_camera_projection_constraint: create a CameraProjectionErrorFunction to constrain a joint so its 3D position projects to a target 2D pixel coordinate
solve_with_multiple_error_functions: build a SkeletonSolverFunction combining PositionErrorFunction and ModelParametersErrorFunction to solve IK with parameter regularization
transform_pose_with_rigid_transform: create a call to transform_pose to apply a rigid transform to model parameters and shift all joint positions
